name: The Doomscroller
why: It forms an impenetrable barrier between you and whatever real-life conversation is happening.

lines.intro: Behold the glowing slab of antisocial invulnerability!
lines.hit: Blocked! The notification shade absorbed all impact!
lines.miss: They put it on airplane mode and completely fumbled!
lines.parried: Reflected! That unsolicited group text was returned to sender!
